summary.scope: Every row of sheets 009–017 was inspected at original sheet resolution with view_image; 108 F/R pairs, station indices 108–215. Four selected original 1280x720 PNGs were additionally inspected and their checks are listed separately. All judgments remain AI proposals, not canonical human review; paired counterparts not listed in original_checks remain contact-sheet observations.
summary.pattern: Readable roadside banks/walls recur throughout. Long articulated cliff bands are strongest in many reverse views in sheets 013–017, while other pairs show only low ridges or partially clipped upper terrain. Near-bank detail and larger face/skyline requirements are separate.
summary.field_limits: near_profile is the strongest readable roadside form in either view. Side fields identify notable raised nearby bank/wall forms, not flat shoulder strips. dominant_wall and panorama refer only to the shown pair; absent does not establish absence elsewhere. panorama=present requires a distinct distant ridge/skyline/panorama region, not the outline of the same B massif or a sea horizon alone. No field is a world-space A/B/C assignment or permission to simplify.
summary.unknowns: Repeated physical-surface identities, unshown approaches, precise image occupancy and all world footprints remain unresolved. Cropped or ambiguous broad faces are uncertain.
summary.exclusions: No Street View, performance measurement, natural class inferred from diagnostic colours, GEO_FIX, D or approved background simplification.
summary.original_check_corrections: Station 113 forward side: both to right; station 204 strongest near profile: bank to wall. B/C statuses unchanged; original checks do not establish world-space surface identities.
